title: Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent sessions may involve frequent context edits, which effectively invalidate cached KV state and force requests to wait for re-prefill before decoding. We present Callo, a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated KV for speculative drafts to reduce this latency, while verifying drafts against the exact KV after prefill before committing tokens. Callo makes effective use of decode resources by scheduling speculations during periods of underutilization and preempting speculations when drafts are likely to not be accepted. We evaluated Callo on a two-GPU testbed using SWE-agent sessions across three model families, observing all-request speedups of 1.05-1.19x over vLLM at moderate load. We demonstrate that these gains are also realized at scale through cluster-level simulations driven by real-world traces.

translated_title: Callo：在预填充-解码分离架构下利用失效KV进行投机解码以服务缓存未命中请求
translated_abstract: 智能体会话可能涉及频繁的上下文编辑，这会使缓存的KV状态失效，迫使请求在解码前等待重新预填充。我们提出了Callo，一种分离式服务系统，它利用失效的KV生成投机草稿以减少这种延迟，同时在预填充完成后、提交token之前，用精确的KV对草稿进行验证。Callo通过在解码资源利用率不足的时期调度投机计算，并在草稿可能不被接受时抢占投机计算，从而有效利用解码资源。我们在双GPU测试平台上使用三个模型系列的SWE-agent会话对Callo进行了评估，观察到在中等负载下所有请求相比vLLM获得1.05-1.19倍的加速。我们通过由真实世界轨迹驱动的集群级仿真证明，这些收益在大规模场景下同样能够实现。
tldr: Callo是一种预填充-解码分离的服务系统，通过利用失效KV缓存进行投机解码草稿生成并在预填充后用精确KV验证草稿，将缓存未命中请求的处理速度提升1.05-1.19倍。
en_tdlr: Callo is a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated KV caches for speculative draft generation, verifying drafts against exact KV after prefill, achieving 1.05-1.19x speedup for cache-miss requests.
